scope: Supporting experiments: valid mixer periods, rejected cost shift and a 20-seed direct comparison. Shared scientific settings are loaded from study.json.

robustness_comparison.initialisation: shared depth-one random start; duplicate own method/optimizer/seed depth-one final angles at depth two
robustness_comparison.bootstrap_method: 95% percentile interval for the median of paired XY-minus-penalty differences; a separate PCG64 generator with the same seed per optimizer/n/depth group; no multiple-comparison correction

symmetries.cost_condition: T*(E_z-E_ref) must be an integer multiple of 2*pi for every energy in the relevant spectrum
